name: v_idle
prompt: A 2D flat cartoon illustration of a young woman with an auburn bob haircut, mustard yellow sweater, teal trousers and brown boots, standing on the spot in a relaxed idle pose. She breathes gently, blinks once, tilts her head slightly and smiles, her hair sways a little. Her feet stay planted on the ground, she does not walk. Static camera, fixed framing, full body visible, plain flat light grey background, clean flat shapes, consistent character.
